name: fincommerce
description: Enterprise e-commerce and payment simulation platform using NestJS microservices.

scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate -w auth-service && npm run prisma:generate -w user-service && npm run build -w @fincommerce/common && npm run build -w auth-service && npm run build -w user-service
scripts.test: npm run prisma:generate -w auth-service && npm run prisma:generate -w user-service && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
